summary: Validated 3 FUUSIC web bug fixes. LIGHT/DARK theme login buttons both render as solid pink (#DB2777 / #EC4899) with white text — the invisible-button bug is fixed. Composer Voice QA now correctly opens the in-app VoiceRecorder (sf-voice-recorder with sf-voice-timer, sf-voice-toggle, sf-voice-cancel, sf-voice-upload all present) — no longer opens the OS file chooser. Composer Camera QA opens the CameraCapture view (sf-camera-capture + sf-camera-cancel) — no white screen / JS crash; in this preview, headless chromium's fake video device actually succeeds, so sf-camera-error isn't shown (sf-camera-video + sf-camera-snap render instead). The three hidden file inputs (image/* capture=environment, image/*,video/*, audio/*) are always mounted. Text-only publish succeeds. **BUT**: discovered a HIGH-priority follow-up — the voice-note end-to-end is broken because the backend returns `media_type: "voice"` for audio uploads while the composer-preview AND the feed card both check for `media_type === "audio"`. Result: after uploading an audio file via sf-voice-upload the view switches back to the form but no sf-composer-audio-preview is rendered, and any voice-note moment in the feed would not render the RadioClipPlayer (rc-play). Needs a one-character string alignment.

ui_bugs.issue: After uploading an audio file (via sf-voice-upload hidden input accept=audio/*) the backend returns `media_type: 'voice'` but the preview condition checks `media.media_type === 'audio'` (line ~460). Neither preview nor error is shown — the upload silently 'succeeds' without a visible preview. Fix: either accept both ('voice' || 'audio') or map on write.

`item.media_type === 'audio'` check will not match voice-note moments (backend media_type='voice'), so RadioClipPlayer / rc-play will not render on voice posts in the feed. Fix: `['audio','voice'].includes(item.media_type)`.

integration_issues.flow: Voice note publish → feed audio playback
integration_issues.issue: Audio upload returns media_type='voice' from /api/social/media/upload but composer preview + feed card only match 'audio' — voice posts publish with media_type=voice but neither the preview nor the feed audio player renders.

action_items: Align the 'voice' vs 'audio' media_type string between backend (routes/social_together.py returns 'voice') and the two frontend consumers: (a) design_v2/socialfeed/socialFeedParts.jsx composer preview conditional (line ~459 — `media.media_type === 'audio'`), and (b) design_v2/socialfeed/SocialFeedCard.jsx line 158 (`item.media_type === 'audio'`). Simplest fix: have both frontend conditions accept either literal (`['audio','voice'].includes(x)`), which keeps backward-compat with any legacy 'audio' records.
After fix, retest voice upload → preview → publish → feed shows RadioClipPlayer (rc-play) on the posted voice note.
critical_code_review_comments: In the composer uploadFile() helper, when the backend returns an error (e.g. unsupported_media), setErr IS called correctly, but when it succeeds with an unexpected media_type the UI silently shows no preview. Consider showing a generic 'media attached' chip even when the specific media_type isn't recognised, so users never think the attach silently failed.

/api/social/media/upload normalises audio to 'voice' (routes/social_together.py:_media_kind). That contract diverges from the feed card expectation ('audio') and is undocumented — add a shared constant / enum.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (3/3 primary bugs fixed; 1 downstream string-mismatch found that breaks voice-note preview + feed playback)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary bug fixes verified: (1) Light theme Sign in button is solid pink (rgb(219,39,119)=#DB2777) ✓; (2) sf-qa-voice opens sf-voice-recorder with timer/mic/back/upload ✓; (3) sf-qa-camera opens sf-camera-capture ✓ (no crash — in headless preview the fake video device makes camera succeed instead of showing sf-camera-error; both paths are coded). Composer text publish works. The 'voice vs audio' media_type string mismatch is a NEW regression surfaced by the voice-recorder path — fix the two frontend consumers to accept either 'audio' or 'voice' then retest the voice upload → preview → publish → feed card RadioClipPlayer (rc-play) flow.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE of the newly-found 'no voice-note preview / no feed audio player' bug: /app/backend/routes/social_together.py `_media_kind()` returns 'voice' for any content-type starting with 'audio/' (line 79-ish). But /app/frontend/src/design_v2/socialfeed/socialFeedParts.jsx composer preview (line 459) and /app/frontend/src/design_v2/socialfeed/SocialFeedCard.jsx (line 158) both compare strictly against the literal 'audio'. REPRO: login as demo@bigfm.dubai → open composer → click Voice (sf-qa-voice) → click Upload file (sf-voice-upload) → pick any .wav/.mp3 file. Expected: audio preview + Share. Actual: view returns to form, no preview, no error. Published post gets media_type='voice' which also won't render RadioClipPlayer in the feed. MITIGATION: in both frontend files replace `item.media_type === 'audio'` with `['audio','voice'].includes(item.media_type)` (two-line change, no backend change needed).
